categories.title: Getting started
categories.summary: The E1 window: menus, the left rail, the explorer, tabs, the side panel, the status bar, the command palette, keyboard shortcuts, your settings and Help.

categories.title: Installation and sign-in
categories.summary: Open E1 in the browser or the desktop app, sign in with your company account or Microsoft, passkeys, sessions and the store E1 runs on.

categories.title: Projects and the explorer
categories.summary: Create, rename, arrange and delete projects and folders, the sections of a project, the Bin, searching and dragging in the explorer.

categories.title: Objects, attributes and tags
categories.summary: Make equipment and other objects from library classes, fill in attributes with units, relate objects, and tag them with your project's rules.

categories.title: Drawing P&IDs
categories.summary: The sheet view: place symbols, draw pipes, signals and cables, select, move, format, layers, flow, off-page connectors and loop diagrams.

categories.title: Lists and queries
categories.summary: Any list is a live query of the model: columns, filters, grouping, editing like Excel, templates, and Excel export and import.

categories.title: Documents, revisions and datasheets
categories.summary: Documents and their revisions, issuing, changed since, PDF and Excel output, sheet PDF and printing, datasheets and the datasheet designer.

categories.title: Working together
categories.summary: History and undo, comments and mentions, tasks and the Inbox, comments pinned on drawings, attachments and live updates between people.

categories.title: Organization, members and access
categories.summary: Your organization, invitations, licenses and seats, project members and roles, exporting the organization, and the access control being built.

categories.title: Configuration, library and catalogs
categories.summary: The Configuration place: classes, attributes, shapes, the company library with drafts, publishing and upgrades, catalogs, content packages and project settings.

categories.title: AI: Alex and Cloud AI
categories.summary: Alex, the built-in engineering co-worker that reviews your drawing, and Cloud AI, the chat that answers and changes the project with review and undo.

categories.title: Your account, Academy and website
categories.summary: The account page on lanxtor.com: licenses, usage, organizations, projects, billing, downloads, the Academy with courses and certificates, Shape E1 and Alex on the website.

features.title: Open a query with New query…
features.summary: Opens a live table of every object below a project, section, folder, sheet or object.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

features.title: Sort by a column
features.summary: Click a column header to sort the rows ascending or descending.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

features.title: Choose the columns
features.summary: Add properties, attributes and related objects as columns with the Columns picker.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

features.title: Engineering columns: Designation, Owner path and related objects
features.summary: Show an object's designation, its owner path, and what it connects to, by name or as a count.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

training.topic: Engineering columns for an equipment list

features.title: Catalog columns
features.summary: Show which catalog item an object was made from, its version and whether an update is available.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

features.title: Filter rows with AND, OR and NOT
features.summary: Build a filter from conditions joined by AND or OR, each one optionally negated with NOT.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

training.topic: Filtering with AND, OR and NOT

features.title: Read the filter in words and clear it
features.summary: The active filter is shown above the table in plain language; Clear filter removes it.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

features.title: Ask when opened: one query for many values
features.summary: Leave a filter value out so whoever opens the query types it in each time.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

training.topic: Queries that ask for a value

features.title: Group & totals
features.summary: Group the rows by a column and add a sum, minimum, maximum, average or count per attribute.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

features.title: Save a query as a template and reopen it under Query ▸
features.summary: Save the columns, filter, sort and grouping as a named template for yourself, the project or the organization.
features.roles: For me: may view the project. For this project: may configure the project. For the organization: may publish to the company library

training.topic: Saving a list as a template

features.title: Edit a cell like in Excel
features.summary: Double-click or press F2 on a cell to change a name or an attribute value; Ctrl+Z undoes it.
features.roles: A project role that may edit objects

features.title: Paste a block from Excel
features.summary: Paste cells copied from Excel into the table; a preview shows every change or problem first.
features.roles: A project role that may edit objects

features.title: Select many cells and Set value…
features.summary: Select a block of cells and give them all one value in one undoable step.
features.roles: A project role that may edit objects

features.title: Fill down and Fill right
features.summary: Copy the top or left cell into the selected cells, counting on values that end in a number.
features.roles: A project role that may edit objects

features.title: Find and replace…
features.summary: Replace text in one column or in the selected cells, with a count of the matches first.
features.roles: A project role that may edit objects

training.topic: Find and replace in a list

features.title: Owner cell: open the object, or move it with F2
features.summary: Double-click an Owner cell to open the object; press F2 to move it to another owner.
features.roles: A project role that may edit objects (to move)

features.title: Export a query to Excel or CSV
features.summary: Download every row of the query as an Excel workbook or a CSV file, with an E1 id column.
features.roles: A project role that may export

features.title: Update from Excel… with Check and Apply
features.summary: Read an exported file back: Check lists every change row by row, Apply makes them in one undoable step.
features.roles: A project role that may edit objects

features.title: Import Excel…: bring a tag list into a section
features.summary: Import an Excel or CSV tag list into a section: matching rows are updated, the others become new objects.
features.roles: A project role that may edit objects

training.topic: Importing a tag list from Excel

features.title: File → Export Excel…: every saved query in one workbook
features.summary: Download one workbook for the project with a sheet per saved query.
features.roles: A project role that may export

features.title: Query over every project of the organization
features.summary: One query over the objects of every project you may view, opened from the organization name.
features.roles: Rows from every project the person may view

features.title: Queries from a sentence
features.summary: Type a sentence such as “all pumps without a motor” and get the matching table.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

training.topic: Asking for a list in a sentence

features.title: The Revisions section
features.summary: The project section that holds every document and its revisions.
features.roles: Any project role

features.title: New document…: list, plot, uploaded or datasheet document
features.summary: Make a document in the Revisions section by choosing its kind.
features.roles: A project role that may write documents

features.title: List documents from a saved query, with PDF and Excel
features.summary: A list document shows a saved query from a starting point and prints it to PDF and Excel with a title block.
features.roles: A project role that may write documents; export needs a role that may export

features.title: Uploaded documents: revise a PDF from outside
features.summary: Keep a PDF made elsewhere as a document and attach files to each revision.
features.roles: A project role that may write documents

features.title: Add revisions A, B, …
features.summary: Add a revision with its label, description and files; E1 proposes the next label.
features.roles: A project role that may write documents

features.title: Draft and In review
features.summary: Mark a revision that is not issued yet as Draft or In review.
features.roles: A project role that may write documents

features.title: The Updated mark on Revisions
features.summary: The Revisions row shows Updated when a colleague added a revision since you last looked.
features.roles: Any project role

features.title: Issue a revision
features.summary: Issuing freezes a revision and its PDF; an issued revision cannot change afterwards.
features.roles: A Lead on the project; an Engineer is refused

features.title: Changed since Rev A, and Modified and Added marks
features.summary: After an issue, the document lists what changed since, and the explorer marks each changed object.
features.roles: Any project role

training.topic: What changed since the last issue

features.title: PDF of a P&ID sheet
features.summary: File → Export PDF… plots the open sheet to a vector PDF with a border and a title block.
features.roles: A project role that may export

features.title: Print… and Ctrl+P
features.summary: Print the open sheet with File → Print… or Ctrl+P (⌘P).
features.roles: A project role that may export

features.title: Plot documents: sheet, page format and layers
features.summary: A plot document prints a sheet on a chosen page format with chosen layers, and has revisions.
features.roles: A project role that may write documents; output needs a role that may export

features.title: Open an object's datasheet
features.summary: Double-click an object to open its datasheet, the object's everyday screen.
features.roles: Any project role (also read-only users)

features.title: Edit values on the datasheet
features.summary: Type values straight into the datasheet; units are added and checked, and Undo takes a change back.
features.roles: A project role that may edit objects

features.title: Datasheet PDF
features.summary: Export PDF on the datasheet writes the layout's fields, section by section, to a PDF.
features.roles: A project role that may export

features.title: Datasheet documents
features.summary: A datasheet document puts an object's datasheet under revision control.
features.roles: A project role that may write documents

features.title: The datasheet designer
features.summary: Copy or create a datasheet layout, add fields, preview it with an object, and publish it for a class.
features.roles: Datasheet design on the project

features.title: Filter documents by kind
features.summary: The All ▾ filter on the Revisions page is meant to show only drawings, lists or datasheets.
features.roles: Any project role

features.title: Standard specification datasheets (ISA 20, API)
features.summary: Specification datasheets in the industry formats, with operating-case tables and repeated blocks.
features.roles: Datasheet design on the project

features.title: Undo and redo your changes
features.summary: Take back your last saved change and put it back, one step per saved change, with your own list of steps.
features.roles: Anyone who may make the change

features.title: See an object's changes and undo one
features.summary: The History tab of an object lists when, who and what changed, with before and after, and Undo this change takes one back.
features.roles: Anyone who may view the object; undo needs permission to make the edit

features.title: The History place: every change in the project
features.summary: One place with the changes from the drawing, Cloud AI and agents, filtered by date, person and kind, with undo for Cloud AI changes.
features.roles: Anyone who may view the project

features.title: Comment on an object: mentions, links, replies and likes
features.summary: Discuss an object on its Comments tab: @mention a colleague, #link an object, reply, like, edit, delete and resolve.
features.roles: Reviewer role or above with an Editor or Reviewer license to write; Engineer and above to resolve

features.title: Give someone a task
features.summary: Ask a person to do something about an object, with a due date; they see it in the Inbox and mark it done.
features.roles: Engineer and above to create; the assignee may always mark it done

features.title: The Inbox: mentions, replies and tasks
features.summary: The bell on the left rail shows your unread notices and opens the Inbox with its views Assigned to me, Mentions, I assigned and All.
features.roles: Every signed-in person

features.title: Choose which notices come by email
features.summary: In Settings, choose for mentions, replies and tasks whether they also come by email.
features.roles: Every signed-in person, for themselves

features.title: Pin a comment on a drawing: Comment here and Needs review
features.summary: Pin a numbered comment on a sheet; the object shows Needs review until the comment is resolved.
features.roles: Anyone who may comment; Engineer and above to resolve

features.title: Attach files to an object or a project
features.summary: Keep PDFs, spreadsheets and drawings with an object or a project, with a PDF preview.
features.roles: A role on the project

features.title: See others' changes live
features.summary: Several people on one project see each other's changes within seconds, without reloading.
features.roles: Everyone with a role on the project

features.title: When two people change the same thing
features.summary: The first change is kept, the second is refused with a clear message and the copy is reloaded.
features.roles: Everyone

features.title: Messages (direct messages)
features.summary: A placeholder place for direct messages; it shows an example and sends nothing.
features.roles: Everyone

features.title: Branches: work apart, then push your changes
features.summary: Planned: your own working copy of part of the design, with pull, conflict resolution and push.
features.roles: Not yet decided

features.title: Merge requests, branch types and branch permissions
features.summary: Planned: merge requests reviewed by a colleague, branch types, automatic resolution rules and push and approval permissions.
features.roles: Not yet decided

features.title: The Organization dialog
features.summary: File → Organization… holds the members with licenses and roles, invitations, groups, the audit and the export, with the trial, credits, files and seats used.
features.roles: Owner or Administrator with a passkey

features.title: Invite a colleague
features.summary: Invite a person by email with a license; they sign in with that address and join the organization.
features.roles: Owner or Administrator with a passkey

features.title: Licenses and seats
features.summary: Each member has one license that caps their roles; Owners and Administrators are told when a license is 80 % and 100 % used.
features.roles: Owner or Administrator with a passkey

features.title: Organization roles and the passkey rule
features.summary: Organization roles and why Owner, Administrator and Project administrator take effect only after you add a passkey; confirming it is you.
features.roles: Everyone, for their own account

features.title: Project members and roles
features.summary: Give a person or group a role on a project in its Members dialog: Project administrator, Lead engineer, Engineer, Reviewer or Viewer.
features.roles: Project administrator with a passkey

features.title: Roles on a single drawing: Share and Mark as read-only
features.summary: Give someone a role on one sheet only, or keep a finished sheet from being changed.
features.roles: Project administrator

features.title: Why a change is refused
features.summary: A refusal names the missing permission, where it was needed and whether the role, the license, a passkey or an ended trial is the reason.
features.roles: Everyone

features.title: Groups
features.summary: Collect people in a group to give them a role together.
features.roles: Owner or Administrator with a passkey

features.title: Audit: what administrators and Cloud AI did
features.summary: The Audit tab lists the organization's important events and what was sent to an AI model.
features.roles: Owner or Administrator with a passkey

features.title: Export everything of the organization
features.summary: An Owner downloads the whole organization in one archive after confirming it is them with a passkey.
features.roles: Owner or Administrator with a passkey

features.title: Trials and the read-only lock
features.summary: A 30-day trial organization; afterwards it is read-only but can still be viewed and exported.
features.roles: Everyone in the trial organization

features.title: Blocked email domains
features.summary: Some email domains get no account, trial, invitation or license.
features.roles: Applies to everyone; kept by LANXTOR

features.title: Permission categories and custom roles
features.summary: Under development: every permission in plain words by category, and your own roles copied from the built-in ones.
features.roles: Owner or Administrator

features.title: Assign to…: objects a person or group is responsible for
features.summary: Under development: make a person or group responsible for objects, which others then see read-only with the reason.
features.roles: Engineer and above; Project administrator to reassign

features.title: Access history and audit export
features.summary: Under development: every change to groups, roles and assignments, access on a date, and export to Excel or CSV.
features.roles: Owner or Administrator

features.title: Company single sign-on and directory sync
features.summary: Planned: sign in with the company account and get colleagues from the company directory; Microsoft sign-in is a first part.
features.roles: Set up by LANXTOR with your IT

features.title: Tokens, service accounts and agents
features.summary: Planned: accounts and tokens for other systems and agents, each with its own access.
features.roles: Not yet decided

features.title: Discipline permissions, four-eyes approval and support access
features.summary: Planned: roles limited to one discipline, a second approver on merge requests, and time-limited support access.
features.roles: Not yet decided

features.title: The Configuration place
features.summary: Find the shared set-up of E1: data model, company library, catalogs, content packages, project settings and installation.
features.roles: Everyone may look; changes need the rights named in each section

features.title: Look up object classes
features.summary: See every kind of object with its attributes, shapes, relationships and where it may be placed.
features.roles: Everyone

features.title: Attributes and a project's pick lists
features.summary: Look up attribute definitions and give a text or choice attribute a project's own pick list.
features.roles: Everyone may look; editing a project's pick list: Project administrator

features.title: Shapes and the Standard filter
features.summary: Look up the symbols E1 draws, filtered by standard such as ISA 5.1, with ports, size and the classes using them.
features.roles: Everyone

features.title: Relationship types
features.summary: Look up the kinds of links between objects, their direction and where they show.
features.roles: Everyone

features.title: The company library: drafts, publishing and versions
features.summary: Add your organization's own attributes, classes and relationship types as drafts and publish them to every project.
features.roles: Owner or Library administrator (company); Project administrator (This project only)

training.topic: Your own classes in the company library

features.title: Updates available and Check against projects
features.summary: See what in a project is on an older library version, and check which objects a draft would break before publishing.
features.roles: Check against projects: Owner or Library administrator

features.title: Upgrade objects to a new class version
features.summary: Preview and apply an upgrade of objects to a new class version in one undoable step; discard retired values.
features.roles: Lead engineer or above

features.title: This project only: the project library
features.summary: Publish classes and attributes that only one project has.
features.roles: Project administrator

features.title: Convention templates for tag rules
features.summary: Publish tag rules as a template, apply it to a project and take over new versions when you choose.
features.roles: Publish: Owner or Library administrator; apply: Project administrator

features.title: Pin a project to a library version
features.summary: Keep a project on an earlier company library version, with a preview, through Cloud AI.
features.roles: Project administrator

features.title: Catalogs of approved products
features.summary: Keep approved products with their data and vendor documents in versioned company or project catalogs.
features.roles: Owner, Library administrator or Catalog maintainer (company); Project administrator (project catalogs); everyone may read

features.title: Make an object from a catalog item
features.summary: Create an object filled with a catalog item's values and see which values differ from the catalog.
features.roles: Anyone who may create objects

features.title: Re-apply a catalog item, or detach from it
features.summary: Bring objects up to a new catalog item version while keeping hand-changed values, or end the link.
features.roles: Re-apply: may edit attributes; Detach: may edit the object

features.title: Content packages and standards
features.summary: See the content packages Core, Electrical foundation, Plant engineering and CFIHOS, and which ones a project uses.
features.roles: Everyone may look; switching: Project administrator

features.title: Project settings: packages, drawing and tag rules
features.summary: Set a project's content packages, crossing-line style and tag rules, for one or several projects at once.
features.roles: Changing: Project administrator; looking: everyone in the project

features.title: Project defaults
features.summary: See the settings a new project starts with (read only for now).
features.roles: Everyone

features.title: Alex knowledge: your company's conventions
features.summary: Give Alex your company's standards, accept the conventions it proposes, and let it learn usual values from your projects.
features.roles: Engineering standards owner, Library administrator or Owner; accepting needs the permission to approve conventions

features.title: Datasheet layouts
features.summary: Find the datasheet layouts of the project, the company and the content packages, and open the designer.
features.roles: Project layouts: Lead engineer or above; company layouts: Owner or Library administrator

features.title: The Cloud AI model of the installation
features.summary: See which model Cloud AI uses in your installation, or whether it is off or runs locally.
features.roles: Everyone may look

features.title: Storage
features.summary: Where the installation keeps its data (placeholder).
features.roles: Everyone

features.title: Rules: calculations, check rules and copy rules
features.summary: Calculated values, check rules with findings, and copy rules between objects.

features.title: Units of measurement
features.summary: Work in real units of measurement and change the units shown.

features.title: Switching content packages on and off
features.summary: Switch a package on or off and see its classes and symbols appear or disappear, with a check of what still uses it.
features.roles: Project administrator

features.title: Content package licensing and updates
features.summary: See which packages your license covers and install package updates into a project.

features.title: Catalog import
features.summary: Import a catalog from a spreadsheet.
